text: InputManager.maxDistance = 200 is a compile-time initialiser, not a gameplay base. setStance calls InputManager.setMaxDistance(slashLength) on every battle init for the local player (web §1t99s0§.as:3156-3158, android MCSPlayer.as:3092-3094), so the 200 is overwritten before the player ever draws a stroke.
